description.zh-CN: 跨会话持久记忆：存 / 取 / 列举 / 搜索 / 删除（写入可机械撤销）
description.en-US: Cross-session memory: put / get / list / search / delete (writes undoable)

tools.name: memory.put
tools.description: Store a value under a key in the persistent memory database (survives across sessions). Args: key (required, unique identifier), value (required, text), tags (optional, short label). Overwrites any existing value; the overwritten entry is returned in `previous` and can be restored via memory.undo. Use it for facts, decisions and user preferences worth remembering; do NOT store secrets or large blobs.

key.description: unique identifier, max 512 bytes; use dotted namespaces like `user.language`

tools.name: memory.get
tools.description: Read one memory entry by exact key. Returns {found, key, value, tags, updated_at}; found=false when the key is absent.

tools.name: memory.list
tools.description: List memory entries ordered by key. Args: prefix (optional key-prefix filter), limit (default 50, max 200), offset (default 0). Returns {total, entries: [{key, value, tags, updated_at}]} where total counts ALL matching entries.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.description: Substring search across keys, values and tags (ASCII case-insensitive). Args: query (required), limit (default 20, max 100). Returns {query, matches}. Wildcards in the query are matched literally.

query.description: substring to search for; % and _ are literal

tools.name: memory.delete
tools.description: Delete one memory entry by exact key. The deleted entry is returned in `previous_entry` and can be restored via memory.undo; deleting a missing key is a no-op.

tools.name: memory.undo
tools.description: Undo a previous memory.put or memory.delete by restoring the entry captured in its result. Usually invoked by the compensation layer, not by the model. Args mirror the compensation payload {call_id, args, output}; only output.previous (for put) or output.previous_entry (for delete) is used. Irreversible — restoring overwrites the entry's current content, so the call requires user approval.

call_id.description: id of the original memory.put / memory.delete call

output.description: original call result carrying previous or previous_entry
